jobs.description:
At Alcon, we're passionate about enhancing sight and helping people see brilliantly. With more than 25,000 associates, we innovate fearlessly, champion progress, and act swiftly to impact global eye health. We foster an inclusive culture, recognizing your contributions and offering opportunities to grow your career like never before. Together, we make a difference in the lives of our patients and customers. Are you ready to join us?

This role is part of Alcon's Supply Chain function, a team that manages the logistics, inventory management, and supply chain analytics for Alcon's industry leading products to ensure products are delivered efficiently and effectively so that people can see brilliantly. The Associate, Inter Company Order & Invoice Flow (Professional Path), is primarily responsible for managing inter-company orders and ensuring compliance with customs, regulatory, and financial requirements until delivery and receipt at the warehouse.

In this role, a typical day will include:
• Execute and update all inter-company orders until delivery and receipt at the warehouse, ensuring compliance with customs, regulatory, and financial requirements
• Apply specialized knowledge to perform tasks and achieve project goals through effective task completion, following procedures with some decision-making authority
• Adhere to GxP regulations by strictly following Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and maintaining accurate and complete documentation, ensuring rigorous quality control
• Complete all required training and meet individual job requirements, contributing to the overall compliance of the organization
• Commit to continuous improvement in operations. All associates must adhere to GxP regulations by strictly following Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), maintaining accurate and complete documentation, ensuring rigorous quality control, and completing all required training. Associates are responsible for meeting their individual job requirements and contributing to the overall compliance of the organization. Compliance with regulatory requirements and a commitment to continuous improvement are essential to our operations​.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING TO ALCON:

• 3-5 years in an international customer service.

• Experience in OTI (order to Invoice) module of ERP (preferred SAP). (High proficiency)

• Advanced Excel knowledge (crosstab, pivot, vlookup, macros, scripts, …).

• Communication Skills: Demonstrate ability to effectively and efficiently communicate with geographically or functionally dispersed teams. (High proficiency)

• Time management: Manage time effectively, prioritizing tasks. Ability to handle urgent and unforeseen requests. Ability to work to deadlines. Maintains effective performance under time pressure. (High proficiency)

• Stakeholder management: Ability to deal and satisfy diverse set of internal and external stakeholders: customers, production planners, export specialists, country CFOs, marketing, RA, GTC, APL (High proficiency)

HOW YOU CAN THRIVE AT ALCON:
● Manage your own workload and schedule while hitting your set targets
● Collaborate with teammates to share best practices and learnings as work evolves
● See your career like never before with focused growth and development opportunities

• Appliquer les connaissances spécialisées pour exécuter les tâches et atteindre les objectifs du projet en exécutant efficacement les tâches, en suivant les procédures avec un certain pouvoir de décision
• Adhérer aux règlements GxP en suivant strictement les procédures d'exploitation normalisées (SOP) et en conservant une documentation précise et complète, assurant un contrôle rigoureux de la qualité
• Compléter toute la formation requise et satisfaire aux exigences de chaque emploi, contribuant à la conformité globale de l'organisation
• S'engager à améliorer continuellement les opérations. Les associés sont responsables de répondre à leurs besoins individuels et de contribuer à la conformité globale de l'organisation. La conformité aux exigences réglementaires et l'engagement à l'amélioration continue sont essentiels à nos opérations. Ce que vous allez apporter à Alcon:
• 3-5 ans dans un service à la clientèle international.
• Expérience dans le module de PGI (commande à facturer) ( SAP préféré). (Haute compétence)
• Connaissances Excel avancées (crosstab, pivot, vlookup, macros, scripts, ...).
• Compétences en communication : Démontrer la capacité de communiquer efficacement avec des équipes dispersées géographiquement ou fonctionnellement. (Haute compétence)
• Gestion du temps : Gérer le temps efficacement, hiérarchiser les tâches. Capacité à traiter les demandes urgentes et imprévues. Capacité de travailler dans les délais. Maintient une performance efficace sous pression temporelle. (Haute compétence)
• Gestion des intervenants : Capacité de traiter et de satisfaire divers intervenants internes et externes : clients, planificateurs de production, spécialistes de l'exportation, OPC par pays, marketing, RA, CGV, APL (haute compétence) Comment pouvez-vous vivre à Alcon? ● Gérez votre propre charge de travail et votre calendrier tout en atteignant vos cibles définies ● Collaborer avec les coéquipiers pour partager les meilleures pratiques et les apprentissages à mesure que le travail évolue ● Voir votre carrière comme jamais auparavant avec des opportunités de croissance et de développement ciblées Alcon Carrières Consultez votre impact sur alcon.com/careers ATTENTION: Employé actuel/travailleur contingent Si vous êtes actuellement un employé ou un travailleur actif à Alcon, veuillez cliquer sur le lien approprié ci-dessous pour postuler sur le site de carrière interne. jobs.description:
At Alcon, we're passionate about enhancing sight and helping people see brilliantly. With more than 25,000 associates, we innovate fearlessly, champion progress, and act swiftly to impact global eye health. We foster an inclusive culture, recognizing your contributions and offering opportunities to grow your career like never before. Together, we make a difference in the lives of our patients and customers. Are you ready to join us?

This role is part of Alcon's Commercial & General Management function, a team that oversees the company's commercial strategies to ensure operational efficiency and support strategic decision making as we transform the eye care industry.

The Director, Corporate Strategy & Business Development (Professional Path), is primarily responsible for identifying and developing strategies for acquisitions, licenses, partnerships, and alliances. You will drive comprehensive analysis on opportunities, support strategic projects in new areas, and assist leadership in aligning the organization with strategic goals. Specifics include:Support development of overall corporate development strategy to increase pipeline value via acquisitions, business development and licensing, and partnership and alliances.

In this role, a typical day will include:
• Support BD&L priority area definition across franchises (Surgical, Vision Care & Pharma), including scoping and executing landscape work (jointly with Search & Evaluation and the Franchises), assessing unmet medical need, opportunity sizing, identifying high level product requirements, etc.
• Drive business growth by supporting the evaluation and recommendation of externally sourced product/business opportunities, including:
o Developing opportunity and competitive landscape scans
o Articulating strategic rationale, including “fit” in Alcon portfolio, role in future standard of care, etc.
o Developing early technical perspectives on technologies (in collaboration with S&E, and with input from R&D colleagues)
o Conducting commercial assessments, including working with 3rd parties to conduct market, epidemiology and/or payer research
o Developing business cases and financial analyses, including valuation, P&Ls, cash flow analyses, sensitivity analyses, and other relevant financial metrics
o Leading cross-functional teams to assess opportunities (technical & commercial), including leading due diligence on investment opportunities
o Obtain feedback from project sponsors and key stakeholders, and ensure alignment
o Working with potential partner companies to increase understanding of and scope opportunities
o Identifying risks, mitigation and options to implement
• Present external opportunities to Alcon leaders in various internal settings
When needed, may be involved in deal negotiation, risk mitigation, and execution to implement approved
opportunities, while supporting internal processes to get approval and finalize these deals
• Prepare and develop high quality presentations for internal (e.g., Alcon Deal Committee, Board of Directors) and external use (e.g., industry conferences)
• Represent Alcon and participate in external industry associations, alliances, and partnership for market development

WHAT YOU’LL BRING TO ALCON:
A strong mix of scientific and financial competences is required for this role
• Scientific background: MSc or PhD in a relevant field (e.g., engineering, biology, physics, etc.) or a medical
degree (e.g., OD, MD). MBA is a plus
• Significant knowledge of the pharmaceutical and/or medical device (surgical) industry, preferably in both
fields. Direct experience in ophthalmology is also preferred
• Experience developing commercial assessments and forecasts for pharmaceutical and/or medical device
products, including conducting market research
• At least 8 years of relevant work experience in:
o Consulting at a top-tier firm,
o PE or VC focused on medical devices and/or biopharma, and/or
o BD&L at major pharmaceutical or medical device companies
•

What do you bring to Alcon:

• Full legal qualification, ideally with admission in Switzerland

• At least 5 years of professional experience in a comparable position in an international company or an international commercial law firm

• In-depth knowledge of general commercial law and preferential experience in legal advice for companies in the healthcare sector, especially in the pharmaceutical or medical device industry.

• Negotiable knowledge of German and English in word and writing, knowledge of French is desirable

En tant que conseiller de confiance auprès des principaux intervenants régionaux et mondiaux, le directeur façonne les principales décisions commerciales et stimule l'intégrité financière. Grâce à une forte visibilité du leadership des cadres supérieurs, ce poste joue un rôle essentiel dans la promotion de l'excellence en matière de rapports, dans la promotion de la transformation numérique et dans le renforcement des capacités organisationnelles. Il s'agit d'un des principaux successeurs de l'initiative des Finances internationales, avec une participation et une influence importantes sur les résultats financiers à impact élevé.

• Diriger l ' évolution de la fonction de la FRA en une organisation internationale, à l ' échelle de l ' équipe et du modèle opérationnel pour soutenir la croissance de la région.

• Agir en tant que point de responsabilisation unique (pour la comptabilité technique mondiale, le chef international de la FRA, la fonction Consolidation et établissement de rapports) pour les principales décisions en matière de comptabilité et d'établissement de rapports et la gestion des risques dans les régions.

• Renforcer la capacité de contrôleur, en établissant des partenariats avec les régions afin de bâtir un banc de talents financiers performant et prêt à l'avenir.

At Alcon, we are driven by the meaningful work we do to help people see brilliantly.
As the global leader in eye care, Alcon develops and manufactures innovative products that enhance quality of life by helping people see better. Our purpose-driven culture encourages innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning while providing opportunities for professional growth across a truly global organization.

We are currently seeking a Treasury Manager to join our Global Treasury team as part of the Funding ( External & Internal Funding ) team in Geneva.
This role offers a unique opportunity to contribute to funding and capital markets transactions, capital structure optimization, intercompany financing, and strategic treasury initiatives within a global NYSE/SIX-listed company, while working closely with senior Treasury and Finance leadership, including the Group Treasurer and CFO.
This role is ideally suited for early-career finance professionals seeking to transition into a high-visibility corporate finance and treasury role with significant international exposure and long-term growth opportunities.

A Typical Day as a Treasury Manager, External & Internal Funding
As a Treasury Manager within the External & Internal Funding team, you will:

• Support treasury and corporate finance activities through financial analysis, reporting, and financial modelling.

• Assist in the structuring, execution, and monitoring of intercompany loans, guarantees, and other treasury-related transactions.

• Support intercompany funding strategies, dividend repatriation initiatives, and cash repatriation activities across the Group.

• Monitor affiliate capital structures and support funding recommendations to optimize financing, liquidity, and balance sheet efficiency as well as to mitigate any country risks and financial risks.

• Prepare presentations and decision materials for Finance leadership, the CFO, Finance Committee, Executive Committee, and Board of Directors.

• Support the analysis and execution of Group financing opportunities, including loans, credit facilities, debt issuances, and other debt-like instruments.

• Contribute to funding, capital structure, liquidity management, and refinancing projects across the Group.

• Support analyses related to credit ratings, banking services, and financial counterparties, including materials for interactions with rating agencies, lenders, and core banking partners.

• Maintain and enhance treasury models, dashboards, and reporting tools.

• Monitor financial markets, interest rates, foreign exchange markets, credit markets, and macroeconomic developments.

• Collaborate closely with Treasury, Tax, Accounting, FP&A, Investor Relations, Legal, external auditors, banks, and local finance teams globally.

• Support treasury-related analyses involving tax, accounting, and audit considerations impacting financing and funding structures.

• Drive treasury process improvements, automation initiatives, and system enhancements.

• Prepare recurring Treasury deliverables, including WACC analyses, dividend proposals and payment processes, credit metrics, financing reviews, and materials for management and governance committees.

• Support the maintenance and integrity of the Treasury Management System and related reporting platforms.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING TO ALCON
Education

• Master's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field.

Experience

• 2-3 years of relevant experience in Investment Banking, Corporate Treasury, Treasury Advisory, Consulting, Transaction services, Audit, Consulting, Corporate Finance, or a related field.

• Exposure to financial markets, funding, treasury, or capital markets activities is a strong asset.

• Experience working in a multinational or international environment is a plus.
Technical Skills

• Strong analytical, quantitative, and problem-solving capabilities.

• Advanced Excel and PowerPoint skills.

• Financial modelling, valuation

This role is ideally suited for early-career finance professionals seeking to transition into a high-visibility corporate finance and treasury role with significant international exposure and long-term growth opportunities.

A Typical Day as a Treasury Manager, External & Internal Funding
As a Treasury Manager within the External & Internal Funding team, you will:

• Support treasury and corporate finance activities through financial analysis, reporting, and financial modelling.

• Assist in the structuring, execution, and monitoring of intercompany loans, guarantees, and other treasury-related transactions.

• Support intercompany funding strategies, dividend repatriation initiatives, and cash repatriation activities across the Group.

• Monitor affiliate capital structures and support funding recommendations to optimize financing, liquidity, and balance sheet efficiency as well as to mitigate any country risks and financial risks.

• Prepare presentations and decision materials for Finance leadership, the CFO, Finance Committee, Executive Committee, and Board of Directors.

• Support the analysis and execution of Group financing opportunities, including loans, credit facilities, debt issuances, and other debt-like instruments.

• Contribute to funding, capital structure, liquidity management, and refinancing projects across the Group.

• Support analyses related to credit ratings, banking services, and financial counterparties, including materials for interactions with rating agencies, lenders, and core banking partners.

• Maintain and enhance treasury models, dashboards, and reporting tools.

• Monitor financial markets, interest rates, foreign exchange markets, credit markets, and macroeconomic developments.

• Collaborate closely with Treasury, Tax, Accounting, FP&A, Investor Relations, Legal, external auditors, banks, and local finance teams globally.

• Support treasury-related analyses involving tax, accounting, and audit considerations impacting financing and funding structures.

• Drive treasury process improvements, automation initiatives, and system enhancements.

• Prepare recurring Treasury deliverables, including WACC analyses, dividend proposals and payment processes, credit metrics, financing reviews, and materials for management and governance committees.

• Support the maintenance and integrity of the Treasury Management System and related reporting platforms.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING TO ALCON
Education

• Master's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field.

Experience

• 2-3 years of relevant experience in Investment Banking, Corporate Treasury, Treasury Advisory, Consulting, Transaction services, Audit, Consulting, Corporate Finance, or a related field.

• Exposure to financial markets, funding, treasury, or capital markets activities is a strong asset.

• Experience working in a multinational or international environment is a plus.
Technical Skills

• Strong analytical, quantitative, and problem-solving capabilities.

• Advanced Excel and PowerPoint skills.

• Financial modelling, valuation
